snippet.title: Spartan Survivors :: Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing Spartan Survivors.

Fight hordes of Covenant & Flood in this new game mixing Roguelike, Halo & Bullet Heaven for hundreds hours of mindless fun!

Made by the Community, with the Community, for the Community and available for free in 2025 🎁

The Halo video game franchise © Microsoft Corporation. Spartan Survivors was created under Microsoft's "Game Content Usage Rules" using assets from the Halo video game franchise, and it is not endorsed by or affiliated with Microsoft.
